name: SF6 v-next.6 - Contact Waterfall + Social Attach Gate

parameters.content: SF6 v-next - Contact Waterfall (owner-approved 2026-11-16). For scored companies (fit >= contact_min_fit, cap max_contact_companies, atomic claim, enrichment-once): (1) Facebook page via Tavily search with deterministic name match, (2) website + /contact extract for verbatim emails, FB links and stated size, (3) provider reveal SLOT - counted as provider_pending when provider_enabled and no email found; the Apollo HTTP node lands when the owner creates the Apollo credential (free-plan API access to be verified). Phone already lives on companies from Places and is surfaced by SF8 v-next.5. Every Tavily call writes cost_ledger rows (search $0.008, extract $0.008); spend_cap_usd honoured before any paid node. No send node anywhere.

parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0)::float AS spent_usd FROM cost_ledger WHERE run_id = $1

WITH cand AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.name, c.location, c.website, c.phone, c.source, (c.raw_payload->>'social_url') AS social_url, s.fit_score,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.fit_score DESC, c.id ASC) AS rn
  FROM companies c
  JOIN scores s ON s.company_id = c.id
    AND s.search_profile_id = $1 AND s.profile_version = $2
  WHERE s.fit_score >= $3
    AND c.contact_enriched_at IS NULL
    AND c.quarantined_at IS NULL
    AND (c.contact_claimed_at IS NULL OR c.contact_claimed_at < now() - interval '1 hour')
),
audit AS (
  INSERT INTO selection_audit (run_id, workflow, company_id, rank, fit_score, cutoff, selection_reason, is_first_skipped)
  SELECT $5, 'SF6', id::text, rn::int, fit_score, $3,
         CASE WHEN rn <= $4 THEN 'selected' ELSE 'cap_reached' END,
         (rn = $4 + 1)
  FROM cand WHERE rn <= $4 + 1
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
),
claim AS (
  UPDATE companies c
  SET contact_claimed_at = now(), contact_claim_run_id = $5
  FROM cand
  WHERE c.id = cand.id AND cand.rn <= $4
  RETURNING c.id AS company_id, cand.name, cand.location, cand.website, cand.phone, cand.source, cand.social_url, cand.fit_score AS fit
)
SELECT company_id::text AS company_id, name, location, website, phone, source, social_url, fit, false AS empty_run FROM claim
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, true AS empty_run
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claim)

WITH u AS (
  UPDATE companies SET
    facebook_url = CASE WHEN (facebook_url IS NULL OR facebook_url = '') AND NULLIF($3, '') IS NOT NULL THEN $3 ELSE facebook_url END,
    email = CASE WHEN (email IS NULL OR email = '') AND NULLIF($4, '') IS NOT NULL THEN $4 ELSE email END,
    email_source = CASE WHEN (email IS NULL OR email = '') AND NULLIF($4, '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'website' ELSE email_source END,
    company_size = CASE WHEN (company_size IS NULL OR company_size = '') AND NULLIF($5, '') IS NOT NULL THEN $5 ELSE company_size END,
    size_source = CASE WHEN (company_size IS NULL OR company_size = '') AND NULLIF($5, '') IS NOT NULL THEN $9 ELSE size_source END,
    phone = COALESCE(NULLIF(phone, ''), NULLIF($7, '')),
    contact_enriched_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1 AND contact_claim_run_id = $2
  RETURNING id
),
l1 AS (
  INSERT INTO cost_ledger (run_id, workflow, provider, event_type, units, cost_usd, company_id, idempotency_key)
  VALUES ($2, 'SF6', 'tavily', 'charge', 1, 0.008, $1::text, 'sf6:search:' || $2 || ':' || $1::text)
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
),
l2 AS (
  INSERT INTO cost_ledger (run_id, workflow, provider, event_type, units, cost_usd, company_id, idempotency_key)
  SELECT $2, 'SF6', 'tavily', 'charge', 1, 0.008, $1::text, 'sf6:extract:' || $2 || ':' || $1::text
  WHERE $6 = 1
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
),
l3 AS (
  INSERT INTO cost_ledger (run_id, workflow, provider, event_type, units, cost_usd, company_id, idempotency_key)
  SELECT $2, 'SF6', 'people_finder', 'estimate', 1, 0.01, $1::text, 'sf6:apollo:' || $2 || ':' || $1::text
  WHERE $8 = 1
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u)::int AS updated
